env TZ=UTC
at 2026-08-05T12:00:00Z
mkdir source

# --all includes the selected board and every other board in the store.
exec card --store $WORK/source init --no-config --prefix all- --board-name Primary
exec card --store $WORK/source --json project create Research --prefix res-
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/research-project.json
exec card --store $WORK/source --json board create --project project_11111111111111111111 Research
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/research-board.json

exec card --json --store $WORK/source backup $WORK/all.cardamom --all
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/backup.json
exec card --json --store $WORK/destination restore $WORK/all.cardamom
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/restore.json

exec card --store $WORK/destination --json project list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/projects.jsonl
exec card --store $WORK/destination --json board list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/boards.jsonl
